cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

mechanism: A assigns both apology delivery and future visit planning to B, treating a request for softer wording as evidence the old cancellation pattern continues.
confusable: D53 simply delegates downward; D96 escalates because each new disagreement is interpreted as the same relational recurrence.
comparison: Family-visit explanation work differs from missed-call dinner service penalties.
